meta.title: 1dentity — keep your documents valid and correct
meta.description: Check whether your Aadhaar, PAN and Voter ID agree, and learn how to fix them. In English, Kannada, Hindi and Urdu.

brand.name: 1dentity
brand.unit: A unit of Islamic Information Centre

trust.heading: Why you can trust us
trust.disclaimer: 1dentity is a community help service of Islamic Information Centre. We are not a government office. All applications are submitted on official government portals, and fees are paid only to the issuing authority. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
trust.otpWarning: 1dentity will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
trust.notGovernment: We are not a government office.
trust.officialOnly: We link only to official government portals.
trust.feesToAuthority: Fees are paid only to the issuing authority.

home.title: Are your documents in agreement?
home.intro: Small differences between your Aadhaar, PAN and Voter ID — a spelling, a date, an old address — can block bank KYC, scholarships, pensions and voting. Check yours in about 3 minutes.
home.privacy: Nothing you type leaves your phone.
home.assistedText: A trained 1dentity volunteer can help you at the help desk, on a WhatsApp video call or at a community camp.
home.fullCheckText: The Full Check compares all your documents — birth certificate, marks cards, Aadhaar, PAN, passport and more — and builds a step-by-step plan. You sign in, and you decide what we keep.

start.privacy: Everything you type stays on this phone. We never ask for Aadhaar, PAN or EPIC numbers, OTPs or photos.

signIn.title: Sign in for the Full Check
signIn.intro: The Full Check keeps your documents and results so you can come back to them. Sign in with your mobile number — we send you a 6-digit code by SMS.
signIn.codeNote: This code only signs you in to 1dentity on this website. We will never ask you for an OTP from UIDAI, your bank or any government portal.
signIn.quickCheck: No account is needed for the Quick Check.

fullCheck.title: Before your Full Check
fullCheck.intro: To compare all your documents, 1dentity needs to keep some details about you. Please read what we keep and why.
fullCheck.keep: We keep the details you type or confirm from each document, the target details you choose, and your results.
fullCheck.why: We use them only to find differences between your documents and to plan the corrections.
fullCheck.who: Only you can see them. Our staff see them only if you ask for assisted help (coming soon).
fullCheck.howLong: We keep them until you delete them or close your account. You can do that at any time in Settings.
fullCheck.notGovernment: 1dentity is not a government office. We never change government records — you or the issuing office do.
fullCheck.agree: I have read this and agree to 1dentity keeping these details for my Full Check.
fullCheck.decline: No thanks — use the Quick Check instead

uploads.title: Before you upload
uploads.intro: Uploading is optional. You can always type the details instead.
uploads.keep: We keep the file, encrypted, and the text read from it. The file is never public.
uploads.read: The text is read by software on our own servers. Nothing is used until you check and confirm it.
uploads.aadhaar: For Aadhaar, upload only a masked Aadhaar (only the last 4 digits visible). An image showing the full number is deleted at once.
uploads.howLong: We delete the file 30 days after you confirm the details, or earlier if you ask.
uploads.agree: I agree to 1dentity keeping my uploaded files and their text as described.

assistance.title: Before 1dentity helps you
assistance.intro: A trained 1dentity volunteer will work on this correction with you.
assistance.who: The volunteer assigned to your case, and their supervisor, will see your documents and the details needed for this correction — nothing else, and only while the case is open.
assistance.what: They help you prepare and file the application on the official portal. Only the issuing office can make the correction.
assistance.otp: If the portal sends an OTP, you type it yourself. 1dentity will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
assistance.howLong: Files added to the case are deleted 30 days after it ends. You can withdraw at any time in Settings.
assistance.agree: I agree that the 1dentity staff on my case may see the documents and details needed for it.

reasons.honorific: Only a title such as Mr or Smt differs.
reasons.initials: An initial is used instead of a full name part.
reasons.abbreviation: A name part is shortened (for example "Mohd.").
reasons.transliteration: The same name, spelt differently in English.
reasons.word_order: The name parts are in a different order.
reasons.missing_or_extra_part: A name part is missing or extra.
reasons.different_name: This looks like a different name.
reasons.day_month_swapped: The day and month look swapped.
reasons.placeholder_date: This looks like a placeholder date, such as 1 January.
reasons.unreadable_date: We could not read this date.
reasons.place_renamed: The same place under its old or new name.

roadmap.intro: Do these steps in order. Each correction is made by the issuing office — 1dentity never changes government records.

roadmap.confirmTargetsText: Before correcting anything, choose the details every document should show: {fields}.

reasons.prerequisite: Another correction must be finished first.
reasons.foundational_first: Start with the more basic record — the others are corrected to match it.
reasons.prerequisite_for_others: Other corrections need this one first.
reasons.independent: This can be done on its own.

roadmap.noRule: We do not have verified steps for this yet. Ask the issuing office, or get assisted help.
roadmap.govFeeNote: Paid by you directly to the issuing office — never to 1dentity.
roadmap.govFeeUnknown: Check the current fee on the official site.
roadmap.unverified: Not yet verified by 1dentity — please confirm on the official site.
roadmap.serviceNote: Optional. Separate from the government fee. Assisted help is coming soon.

roadmap.cycle: Some of these steps depend on each other. Follow the official guidance, or get assisted help.

settings.title: Privacy and deletion
settings.intro: You decide what 1dentity keeps. You can withdraw or delete at any time.
settings.notAgreed: You have not agreed to this.
settings.withdrawUploadsText: Deletes every uploaded file and the text read from it. Details you typed or confirmed stay. Uploads you have not checked yet are deleted.
settings.uploadsDone: Your uploaded files have been deleted.
settings.withdrawFullCheckText: Deletes your details, documents, files, targets and reports. Your account stays, and you can start again.
settings.closeText: Deletes everything about you, including your account. Only records with no personal details remain, as the law requires.
settings.confirm: I understand this cannot be undone.
settings.withdrawAssistance: Stop staff access to my documents
settings.withdrawAssistanceText: Withdraws all your open help requests. Staff can no longer see your documents.
settings.assistanceDone: Staff access has ended and your open requests are withdrawn.
settings.smsText: We can send a short SMS when your case changes. It contains only the case ID and a link to this site — never your details.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.version: Notice version {version} · draft for legal review
privacy.intro: 1dentity is a community help service of Islamic Information Centre. We are not a government office. This notice explains what we keep about you and why.
privacy.quickText: The Quick Check runs only on your phone. Nothing you type is sent to us.
privacy.collectTitle: What we keep in the Full Check
privacy.collectText: Your mobile number (to sign you in); the details you type or confirm from your documents; the target details you choose; your results and correction plans; and, only if you upload, the files and the text read from them. For Aadhaar we keep only the last 4 digits — never the full number.
privacy.whyText: To find differences between your documents and to plan how to correct them. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

kept.uploads: 30 days after you confirm the details
kept.profile_and_documents: until you delete them or close your account

privacy.whoText: Only you. Our trained staff see your details only if you ask for assisted help, and every view is recorded.
privacy.securityText: Files and document numbers are encrypted. Files are never on a public link. We will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
privacy.rightsText: You can see your details, correct them, withdraw your agreement and delete everything at any time in "Privacy and deletion".
privacy.grievanceText: Speak to the 1dentity help desk at Islamic Information Centre, Bengaluru. A grievance officer will be named here before the public launch.
privacy.assistText: Only if you ask 1dentity to help with a correction, and agree, the volunteer assigned to your case and their supervisor see the documents and details needed for it. Files added to a case are deleted 30 days after the case ends.

goodbye.closed: Your account and everything in it have been deleted.
